Lagoon Drift.opus.title: Lagoon Drift
Lagoon Drift.opus.description: Half-time tropical dubstep with the bass held back. Marimba plucks and a soft wave swell open into an elastic drop.

Open Water.opus.title: Open Water
Open Water.opus.description: The heavier ocean dub. Loud rolling sub, a controlled wobble, and plucked mallets over a half-time beat.

Island Chords.opus.title: Island Chords
Island Chords.opus.description: Melodic and restrained. Muted piano, plucked guitar, and a slow wobble, with no hard drop.

Airy Marimba.opus.title: Airy Marimba
Airy Marimba.opus.description: The lighter melodic dub. Island chords stay airy, then rounded bass and marimba come in.

Steel Riddim.opus.title: Steel Riddim
Steel Riddim.opus.description: A bright riddim. Steel drum and horn stabs sit forward over a skanking half-time groove.

Bassweight.opus.title: Bassweight
Bassweight.opus.description: The heavy riddim. Gated bass growls under a steel-drum lead and a sunny half-time bounce.

Underwater Groove.opus.title: Underwater Groove
Underwater Groove.opus.description: The darkest of the dubs. Deep underwater bass, soft island drums, and a bright tropical lead.

Lagoon Lead.opus.title: Lagoon Lead
Lagoon Lead.opus.description: Lagoon dubstep with deep sub, marimba leads, and water-droplet delays. A little brighter than the underwater take.

Golden Wobble.opus.title: Golden Wobble
Golden Wobble.opus.description: Sunset dubstep. Warm heavy bass, steel-drum hooks, and a relaxed half-time groove.

Sunlit Pans.opus.title: Sunlit Pans
Sunlit Pans.opus.description: Laid-back island dubstep. Soft steel pans and a wide mix, with less sub than the short pan loop.

Pan Pocket.opus.title: Pan Pocket
Pan Pocket.opus.description: A short, heavy steel-pan loop. Elastic wobble and hand percussion, louder and lower than Sunlit Pans.

Rubber Summer.opus.title: Rubber Summer
Rubber Summer.opus.description: Heavy wobbly sub, punchy drums, and a bright steel-drum melody in a summer groove.

Palm Wobble.opus.title: Palm Wobble
Palm Wobble.opus.description: The brightest dub. Buoyant steel-drum hooks and a rubbery bass swing, with the melody out front.

Rainfield.opus.title: Rainfield
Rainfield.opus.description: Dark storm ambient. Deep sub pulses, soft rain and wind, and long drones with almost no melody.

Safe Distance.opus.title: Safe Distance
Safe Distance.opus.description: Calm documentary ambient. Gentle piano and soft strings, much less bass than the rain piece.

Warm Dusk.opus.title: Warm Dusk
Warm Dusk.opus.description: Slow golden pads and a little high sparkle. No drums and no melody, quiet enough to sit in the background.

Canopy Dark.opus.title: Canopy Dark
Canopy Dark.opus.description: A short night-rainforest drone. Very dark, almost no midrange, meant to sit under coqui frogs.

Wide Canopy.opus.title: Wide Canopy
Wide Canopy.opus.description: The longer night-rainforest bed. Still deep, with a little more air moving through it.

Humid Air.opus.title: Humid Air
Humid Air.opus.description: Gentle tropical ambient. Warm low pads, a few quiet high sparks, and no rhythm.

Warm Humidity.opus.title: Warm Humidity
Warm Humidity.opus.description: The same humid air, filled in. Warmer pads and a heavier low end, still without a beat.

Night Piano.opus.title: Night Piano
Night Piano.opus.description: Sparse felt piano over a warm pad, with long spaces between notes. The brightest and longest of the pair.

Pad Night.opus.title: Pad Night
Pad Night.opus.description: The darker night piece. The pad and low end take over, and the piano stays far back.

Still Bed.opus.title: Still Bed
Still Bed.opus.description: An eight-minute warm drone. Almost static, loud in the low end, with no melody and no sparkle.

Soft Drone.opus.title: Soft Drone
Soft Drone.opus.description: A shorter still drone. Slow movement only, quieter and a little less heavy than Still Bed.

Evening Lounge.opus.title: Evening Lounge
Evening Lounge.opus.description: Warm lounge ambient. Soft pads, a hint of melody, light sparkle, and no heavy drums.

Light Lounge.opus.title: Light Lounge
Light Lounge.opus.description: The shorter lounge. Electric-piano chords and small bell sparks, lighter in the bass.

Aquarium Drift.opus.title: Aquarium Drift
Aquarium Drift.opus.description: Dreamy aquarium ambient. Flowing pads and a watery shimmer, with the low end sitting forward.

Bubble Glass.opus.title: Bubble Glass
Bubble Glass.opus.description: The brighter aquarium. Soft bubble plucks and glass shimmer over a lighter bass.

Sunset Pads.opus.title: Sunset Pads
Sunset Pads.opus.description: Golden pads, slow melodic phrases, and a light ocean-air wash. No percussion.

Insect Night.opus.title: Insect Night
Insect Night.opus.description: Humid night ambient. Soft organic pads and a quiet insect-like sparkle.

Deep Insects.opus.title: Deep Insects
Deep Insects.opus.description: The darker humid night. Warm low drones take more of the room, and the sparkle sits farther back.

Reef Spark.opus.title: Reef Spark
Reef Spark.opus.description: A short coral-reef bed. Soft blue-green pads and delicate sparkle, drifting without a beat.

Coral Glow.opus.title: Coral Glow
Coral Glow.opus.description: The longer reef piece. More shimmer in the top, and a wider underwater wash.

Tropical Mist.opus.title: Tropical Mist
Tropical Mist.opus.description: Airy pads and a gentle high shimmer. Light, open, and slow.

Veranda.opus.title: Veranda
Veranda.opus.description: A short evening veranda. Guitar-like tones folded into warm pads and night air, with little brightness.

Night Guitar.opus.title: Night Guitar
Night Guitar.opus.description: The longer veranda. Soft guitar tones and pads, intimate, with no strong rhythm.

Blue Glass.opus.title: Blue Glass
Blue Glass.opus.description: Aquarium ambient that stays bright. Glassy highs and ripples, with the bass held down.

Deep Aquarium.opus.title: Deep Aquarium
Deep Aquarium.opus.description: The deep blue tank. Rich warm drones, watery movement, and a heavy low end.

Melodic Drift.opus.title: Melodic Drift
Melodic Drift.opus.description: Warm pads and small melodic fragments. The least bass of the ambient beds, and no drums.

Light Reflections.opus.title: Light Reflections
Light Reflections.opus.description: Soft aquarium wash. Warm pads, watery texture, and slow movement with no pulse.

Long Reflections.opus.title: Long Reflections
Long Reflections.opus.description: The longer reflection piece. It opens sparse, blooms into warmer pads, then thins back out.

Evening Breeze.opus.title: Evening Breeze
Evening Breeze.opus.description: Relaxed tropical evening. Soft warm pads, a breeze-like texture, and quiet melodic hints.

Night Breeze.opus.title: Night Breeze
Night Breeze.opus.description: The shorter evening. Darker and lower, with the same calm pace.

Coral Reef.opus.title: Coral Reef
Coral Reef.opus.description: Deep coral-reef drones. Rich warm low end and a subtle watery shimmer.

Golden Hour.opus.title: Golden Hour
Golden Hour.opus.description: Soft glowing pads and a gentle rise. Warm and open, with light melodic touches and no drums.

Glass Water.opus.title: Glass Water
Glass Water.opus.description: Clear warm pads and bubble-like sparkle. Minimal, calm, and bright.

Humid Night.opus.title: Humid Night
Humid Night.opus.description: A long humid night. Organic pads, quiet atmosphere, and a warm heavy low end.

Night Air.opus.title: Night Air
Night Air.opus.description: The shorter humid night. Softer in the bass, still immersive, with no drums.

Soft Wave.opus.title: Soft Wave
Soft Wave.opus.description: The quietest bed. Slow rolling pads and a light shimmer, floating with almost no weight.

Rolling Wave.opus.title: Rolling Wave
Rolling Wave.opus.description: The fuller wave. Soft rolling pads, ocean air, and a rounder low swell. No drums.

Polynesian Night.opus.title: Polynesian Night
Polynesian Night.opus.description: Warm ocean pads, distant island texture, and a light shimmer. No strong drums.

Island Hints.opus.title: Island Hints
Island Hints.opus.description: A short Pacific night. Soft drones and quiet melodic hints, brighter and lighter than the long take.

Pacific Night.opus.title: Pacific Night
Pacific Night.opus.description: The longer island night. Warm drones, an ocean breeze, and a deeper low end.

Moonlit Atoll.opus.title: Moonlit Atoll
Moonlit Atoll.opus.description: Soft glowing pads with water and air. Open, calm, and bright rather than heavy.

Shallow Lagoon.opus.title: Shallow Lagoon
Shallow Lagoon.opus.description: Warm watery pads and a delicate shimmer. Slow, tranquil, and no percussion.

Lagoon Flute.opus.title: Lagoon Flute
Lagoon Flute.opus.description: The longer lagoon. A soft flute-like line appears in the middle, then dissolves into the pad.

Island Breeze.opus.title: Island Breeze
Island Breeze.opus.description: Quiet island night. Organic pads, light wind, and ocean texture, kept soft.

Wind Wash.opus.title: Wind Wash
Wind Wash.opus.description: The shorter breeze. A bit darker, with ocean wash and wind under soft pads.

Deep Pacific.opus.title: Deep Pacific
Deep Pacific.opus.description: Rich warm drones and subtle ocean movement. The heavier of the two Pacific beds.

Soft Pacific.opus.title: Soft Pacific
Soft Pacific.opus.description: The same deep Pacific calm, with less bass and a lighter middle.

Tiki Night.opus.title: Tiki Night
Tiki Night.opus.description: Warm tropical pads and a quiet island mood. Bright, spacious, and light in the low end.

Distant Shore.opus.title: Distant Shore
Distant Shore.opus.description: Warm pads, a light ocean feel, and a gentle high shimmer. No drums.

Low Shore.opus.title: Low Shore
Low Shore.opus.description: The heavier shore. The same calm evening, with the low end brought forward.

Whale Drift.opus.title: Whale Drift
Whale Drift.opus.description: Deep warm ocean drones and distant whale calls. Dark, slow, and drumless.

Whale Calls.opus.title: Whale Calls
Whale Calls.opus.description: The brighter whale piece. The calls sit closer, over a lighter drone.

Deep Whale.opus.title: Deep Whale
Deep Whale.opus.description: The lowest and darkest whale bed. Rich drones, soft distant song, and slow underwater movement.

Sparse Whale.opus.title: Sparse Whale
Sparse Whale.opus.description: Very calm and open. Deep drones, sparse ocean texture, and only a few soft calls.

Icelandic Highlands.opus.title: Icelandic Highlands
Icelandic Highlands.opus.description: Acoustic highland folk. A bowed drone, a slow modal fiddle line, and almost no percussion.

Cooling Rock.opus.title: Cooling Rock
Cooling Rock.opus.description: Low volcanic drones and soft crackle. The darkest and stillest of the lava beds.

Earth Motif.opus.title: Earth Motif
Earth Motif.opus.description: Earthy drones and warm analog pads, with a small ancient melody a little more present.

Stone Hits.opus.title: Stone Hits
Stone Hits.opus.description: Mysterious volcanic ambient. Sub rumbles, glowing pads, and distant hits like falling rock.

Flute Rumble.opus.title: Flute Rumble
Flute Rumble.opus.description: The heavier rock piece. Deep sub, sparse flute, and those distant stone hits.

Lava Piano.opus.title: Lava Piano
Lava Piano.opus.description: Cinematic and close. Low drones, soft piano, and subtle strings, kept out of the way of the view.

Quiet Lava.opus.title: Quiet Lava
Quiet Lava.opus.description: The softer livestream bed. Sustained drones, felt piano, and strings, with less weight.

Ember Bass.opus.title: Ember Bass
Ember Bass.opus.description: Molten and low. Resonant bass, soft ember crackle, and a sparse primal line.
